title: Dow Jones| Nasdaq | S&P 500 | US Stock Market Today |Live Updates: Nasdaq leads Wall Street higher as SpaceX, Super Micro lift AI sentiment - The Economic Times
text:
US Market | Dow Jones Live Updates: Nasdaq leads Wall Street higher as strong results from SpaceX and Super Micro Computer revive appetite for AI stocks. The S&P 500 and Dow also gain, while Netflix, AT&T and Alphabet weigh on the market. Investors remain focused on whether AI spending can deliver sustainable returns.

- Adam Sarhan, chief executive of 50 Park Investments in New York
